name: Darkflare
source: Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 25, Faction Guide pg. 55
body:
Source Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 25, Faction Guide pg. 55
Price 1 gp; Weight —
Category Alchemical Weapons
Description
This alchemical flare explodes in black sparks 1 round after lighting. Any creature with darkvision in the same square as a darkflare when it explodes must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or lose its darkvision for 1d10 rounds. Affected creatures can still use other vision (such as normal vision and low-light vision) with no penalty.
Construction
Craft (Alchemy) DC 25
